command:
set -euo pipefail
ssh -o BatchMode=yes -o ConnectTimeout=10 michal@192.168.0.23 'bash -s' <<'REMOTE'
set -euo pipefail
cd /home/michal/src/PhotoMaps
if [ -n "$(git status --porcelain)" ]; then
  echo 'production checkout is dirty; refusing to switch'
  git status --short --branch
  exit 10
fi
old=$(git rev-parse HEAD)
echo "old_head=$old"
git fetch origin main
git checkout -B main origin/main
new=$(git rev-parse HEAD)
echo "new_head=$new"
git merge-base --is-ancestor "$old" "$new"
echo 'old_develop_is_ancestor=yes'
runtime_diff=$(git diff --name-only "$old".."$new" -- backend/app frontend/src server.py)
if [ -n "$runtime_diff" ]; then
  echo 'unexpected_runtime_diff:'
  printf '%s\n' "$runtime_diff"
  exit 11
fi
echo 'runtime_diff=none'
echo 'health:'
curl -fsS http://127.0.0.1:8000/health
echo
echo 'status:'
git status --short --branch
echo 'branches-before-cleanup:'
git branch -vv
if git show-ref --verify --quiet refs/heads/develop; then
  git branch -d develop
fi
echo 'branches-after-cleanup:'
git branch -vv
REMOTE
